subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a canonical persisted session-level process/step event contract, or should progress remain scoped to narrower surfaces like inter-session streaming, Control UI progress, CLI stdout streaming, and audit sinks?
rationale: The request affects core gateway protocol, session state, UI consumers, diagnostics, and security/redaction policy, so automation cannot safely choose the event taxonomy or persistence boundary.

options.title: Design canonical session events
options.body: Approve a core process/step event contract with persistence, replay, authorization, and redaction requirements before implementation starts.

options.title: Solve narrower consumers separately
options.body: Keep this as umbrella context while solving inter-session streaming, Control UI progress, CLI streaming, and audit logging with separate contracts.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Leave current chat/tool/lifecycle/item/plan streams unchanged until a maintainer-sponsored protocol design exists.

recommendation.title: Design canonical session events
recommendation.body: Approve a core process/step event contract with persistence, replay, authorization, and redaction requirements before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection across the agent event, gateway protocol, and session.tool routing files involved in the design.
